items.label: REUSABLE, REFILLABLE PAINT PEN
items.value: The Slobproof Refillable Touch-up Paint Pen lets you load your own latex wall paint for accurate color matching. The reusable, easy-to-fill design makes refilling fast, clean, and convenient—no paint roller or brush needed.

items.label: HOME IMPROVEMENT TOOLS
items.value: Our easy-to-clean paint pen is ideal for quick maintenance and repairs in apartments, dorms, rentals, or your home. Fix scuffs, dings, or scratches—even in hard-to-reach areas—or add the finishing touch to art projects.

items.label: LONG-LASTING, AIRTIGHT STORAGE
items.value: The patented vacuum-sealed system of our paint pen keeps paint fresh for up to 7 years. No more dried-up cans and crusty brushes—our refillable paint pens eliminate waste and are easier to use than a traditional paint brush.

items.label: MESS-FREE, TWIST-CONTROL PAINT PEN TIP
items.value: Designed for precision, the twist-control mechanism ensures just the right paint flow for smooth, mess-free application. The fine-tip brush applicator ensures clean, even coverage with no drips or splatters.

items.label: DIY PAINT PEN
items.value: Comes with a reusable paint syringe for long-term use. Trusted by homeowners and DIYers, our painting tools work on any surface, including walls, floors, trim, doors, and furniture. Replacement brush tips are also available separately.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 x Filling Syringe, 2 x Brush-Tip, 2 x Protective Cap, 2 x Touch-Up Paint Pen
